exposure: expression of CD15 in feto-placental resistance vessels (FRVs)
cohort: The study included placentas from stillborns/newborns with birth asphyxia (acute and non-acute) and non-hypoxic newborns, including those from pregnancies with preeclampsia and gestational diabetes, along with controls.
finding: A high expression of CD15 in feto-placental resistance vessels (FRVs) was strongly associated with non-acute fetal hypoxia, independently of other placental or maternal conditions.
